# LexWin Legal & HR Consulting

> LexWin is a Pune-based corporate legal and HR advisory firm serving Indian businesses, MNCs, and foreign companies entering India. Practice areas include Corporate Legal Advisory, HR Compliance & Labour Law, Real Estate Legal Due Diligence, and India Entry / Business Setup. Founded by Sadanand Sonar (Bar Council enrolled, background in senior IT management). Tagline: "Precision in law, Clarity in counsel, Speed in execution."

## About

- [About LexWin](https://www.lexwin.co.in/about.html): Firm background, founder profile, and approach.
- [Home](https://www.lexwin.co.in/): Overview of practice areas, who we help, and engagement models.
- [Pune Legal & HR Consultant](https://www.lexwin.co.in/pune-legal-hr-consultant.html): Local presence and services in Pune, Maharashtra.

## Services

- [Corporate Legal Advisory](https://www.lexwin.co.in/services/corporate-legal-consultant.html): Contracts, M&A, governance, DPDP/GDPR compliance, retainer advisory.
- [HR Consulting](https://www.lexwin.co.in/services/hr-consultant.html): HR policies, POSH implementation, labour law compliance, performance management.
- [Business Setup in India](https://www.lexwin.co.in/services/business-setup-india.html): Entity structuring (WOS, Branch Office, LLP, EOR), FDI/FEMA compliance, market entry for foreign companies.
- [Real Estate Legal Due Diligence](https://www.lexwin.co.in/services/real-estate-legal-due-diligence.html): Title verification, land acquisition advisory, lease and sale agreement review.

## Free Tools

- [Free Tools](https://www.lexwin.co.in/free-tools.html): Self-assessment and compliance tools for Indian businesses.
